'''Listener''' was one of the [[subnode]]s of the legendary [[Assembler]] [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] [[Kud'ar Mub'at]]. It was a tympanic membrane that was charged with picking up the sounds within and around the [[Ghostling Nest of the Assembler]].<ref name="EGTAS" />
